DSM 里看到的路径，以共享文件夹开头，如 /research/入库/2026（: The path as DSM shows it, starting with the shared folder, e.g. /research/inbox/2026 (not the /volume1/... path seen in a container or over SSH)
「同名文件」选跳过时，已存在而没有上传的数量: With "Same name" set to skip, how many files already existed and were not uploaded
一个或多个平台文件，按原文件名存放: One or more platform files, stored under their original names
与输入的文件一一对应: One entry per input file, in order
填 true 时不校验 HTTPS 证书，仅用于局域网里 DSM 的自签证书；走: Set to true to skip HTTPS certificate verification, only for a LAN DSM with a self-signed certificate; leave empty over the internet
建议单独建一个只对目标共享文件夹有读写权限的账号；**不能开两步验证**（接口登: Best a dedicated account with read/write access to the target shared folder only; **two-step verification must be off** (an API login cannot enter a code)
把工作流里的文件上传到群晖 NAS 的文件夹，走 DSM 的 FileStati: Upload files from a workflow into a Synology NAS folder through DSM's FileStation API, so Synology Drive / Cloud Sync sync them as usual. **You deploy the plugin process yourself**, on any machine that can reach DSM.
浏览器里打开 DSM 的地址，带协议和端口，如 https://nas.exam: The address you open DSM at in a browser, with scheme and port, e.g. https://nas.example.com:5001 or http://nas.local:5000
用账号密码登录一次 DSM。ok=false 时 message 说明是地址不通: Logs in to DSM once with the account. With ok=false, message tells whether the address, the certificate, the password or two-step verification is the problem
目标文件夹不存在时逐级创建: Create the target folder and its parents when missing
目标文件夹里已有同名文件时怎么办；跳过的文件在结果里标出: What to do when the target folder already has a file of that name; skipped files are marked in the result
经 DSM 的 FileStation 接口把文件传到群晖某个文件夹，Synol: Upload files into a Synology folder through DSM's FileStation API, so Synology Drive / Cloud Sync notice and sync them as usual
